# Explorations with keyATM

## Initialisation

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(keyATM)
library(ggiraph)
library(pins)
library(pinsqs)
library(AzureStor)

source(here::here("R", "azure_init.R"))

theme_set(theme_bw())
set_girafe_defaults(
  opts_toolbar = opts_toolbar(position="topright", saveaspng=FALSE),
  opts_zoom = opts_zoom(min=0.8, max=4)
)

speeches_board <- storage_endpoint("https://cbspeeches1.dfs.core.windows.net/", token=token) %>%
  storage_container(name = "cbspeeches") %>%
  board_azure(path = "data-speeches")

models_board <- storage_endpoint("https://cbspeeches1.dfs.core.windows.net/", token=token) %>%
  storage_container(name = "cbspeeches") %>%
  board_azure(path = "data-models")
```

Reading in the previously constructed data for keyATM:

```{r, eval=FALSE}
speeches <- speeches_board %>%
  pin_qread("speeches-g20-keyATM")
```

The data is then converted once again into a keyATM-specific format.

```{r, eval=FALSE}
keyATM_docs <- keyATM_read(speeches)
```

## Model fitting

The following key topics and their keywords were supplied:

```{r, eval=FALSE}
keywords = list(
  basel = c("basel"),
  cbdc = c("cbdc", "payment"),
  ukraine = c("ukrain"),
  covid = c("covid"),
  brexit = c("brexit"),
  climat = c("climat", "green", "carbon", "emiss", "transit")
)
```

```{r, eval=FALSE}
keyATM_out <- keyATM(
  docs = keyATM_docs,
  no_keyword_topics = 34,
  keywords = keywords,
  model = "base",
  options = list(seed=25, iterations=6000)
)

models_board %>%
  pin_qsave(
    keyATM_out,
    "keyATM-g20-k=40",
    title = "keyATM model for g20 speeches, 40 topics"
  )
```

Read in model and metadata.

```{r}
keyATM_out <- local_board %>%
  pin_qread("keyATM-g20-k=40")

speeches_metadata <- local_board %>%
  pin_qread("speeches-g20-metadata") %>%
  arrange(doc)
```

```{r}
theta <- keyATM_out %>%
  pluck("theta") %>%
  as_tibble()

doc_dates <- speeches_metadata %>%
  select(doc, country, date)

theta_dates <- bind_cols(doc_dates, theta) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = 4:43,
    names_to = "topic",
    values_to = "probability"
  )

summarised_theta_by_month <- theta_dates %>%
  mutate(
    year = year(date),
    month = month(date)
  ) %>%
  group_by(country, year, month, topic) %>%
  summarise(avg_probability = mean(probability, na.rm=TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  unite("date", year, month, sep="-") %>%
  mutate(date = ym(date)) %>%
  drop_na()
```

Create plot topic labels.

```{r}
label_top_words <- keyATM_out %>%
  top_words(show_keyword = FALSE) %>%
  as.list() %>%
  map(str_flatten_comma) %>%
  list_c() %>%
  set_names(colnames(keyATM_out$theta))
```

```{r}
data1 <- summarised_theta_by_month %>%
  filter(topic %in% c("5_brexit", "2_cbdc", "4_covid", "3_ukraine"))

plot1 <- ggplot(data1) +
  geom_line_interactive(
    aes(x=date, y=avg_probability, colour=country, tooltip=country, data_id=country),
    alpha=0.4, show.legend=FALSE
  ) +
  facet_wrap_interactive(
    ~ topic, ncol=1,
    labeller = labeller_interactive(aes(tooltip=label_top_words[topic], data_id=topic))
  ) +
  scale_x_date(breaks = "2 years", date_labels="%Y") +
  labs(x="", y="Averaged topic proportions")

girafe(ggobj = plot1) %>%
  girafe_options(
    opts_hover(css = "stroke-opacity:1;"),
    opts_hover_inv(css = "opacity:0.5;filter:saturate(20%);")
  )
```

```{r, eval=FALSE}
keyATM_out %>%
  top_words(show_keyword = FALSE)
```

```{r}
data2 <- summarised_theta_by_month %>%
  filter(topic %in% c("1_basel", "6_climat", "Other_11", "Other_26"))

plot2 <- ggplot(data2) +
  geom_line_interactive(
    aes(x=date, y=avg_probability, colour=country, tooltip=country, data_id=country),
    alpha=0.4, show.legend=FALSE
  ) +
  facet_wrap_interactive(
    ~ topic, ncol=1,
    labeller = labeller_interactive(aes(tooltip=label_top_words[topic], data_id=topic))
  ) +
  scale_x_date(breaks = "2 years", date_labels="%Y") +
  labs(x="", y="Averaged topic proportions")

girafe(ggobj = plot2) %>%
  girafe_options(
    opts_hover(css = "stroke-opacity:1;"),
    opts_hover_inv(css = "opacity:0.5;filter:saturate(20%);")
  )
```

```{r, eval=FALSE}
write_excel_csv(summarised_theta_by_month, "inst/data-misc/keyATM-time-series-g20.csv")
write_excel_csv(top_words(keyATM_out), "inst/data-misc/keyATM-time-series-g20-topics.csv")
```
